item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow, and it will moderate in the following couple of days. Under the influence of a broad band of clouds, there will be showers over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea midweek next week. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, showers will ease off over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. A surge of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China during the next weekend.
